purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Langata Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve a genuine special-facility denominator gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 4-page document titled 'COLLATION OF PRESIDENTIAL ELECTION RESULTS AT THE CONSTITUENCY TALLYING CENTRE' (page 1 states 'Name of Constituency: LANGATA Code: 277, Name of County: NAIROBI CITY Code: 047'); page 3 of 4 ends in the TOTAL row and page 4 is the closing agent-signature/handover page. The page header banner reads 'CON 277 03/18'. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (LANGATA, code 277, county NAIROBI CITY code 047) was read from the 'Name of Constituency: LANGATA Code: 277' declaration header on page 1 and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 277' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

registered_voters.note: The printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure is 145,870, which is 221 more than the governed P23 constituency denominator (145,649). The two rows immediately above TOTAL are '049292145110901 NAIROBI WEST - 01' (registered 91) and '049292145111001 LANGATA WOMEN PRISON - 01' (registered 130) -- summing to exactly 221, the observed delta -- and their non-ward polling-station code prefix ('049292...') matches the recurring special-facility numbering pattern already documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu's '049292145105401 KIAMBU PRISON'). This is treated as the same genuine national-facility denominator gap, not a transcription error.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-277-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 80,096 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (145,870) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (145,649). The printed Form 34B total includes two special-facility polling stations with non-ward codes (NAIROBI WEST and LANGATA WOMEN PRISON, registered 91+130=221 -- exactly the observed delta), which are outside the ordinary ward-boundary polling-station set used to derive the governed ward-summed registered-voters denominator. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu, Kapseret, Naivasha, Alego Usonga, Suna East, Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West, Garissa Township, Kitui Central, Mwea) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
